title: Labor group: End VAW by tackling patriarchy, inequality

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Labor group Sentro has called for stronger protection against violence against women alongside measures to address economic insecurity and unequal power relations, arguing that awareness campaigns alone cannot end abuse without confronting the patriarchal structures that perpetuate it. In a statement Thursday, Nov. 26, the group said violence against women (VAW) should not be treated solely as individual acts of abuse or private disputes between partners but as a problem reinforced by inequalities in employment, wages, political representation and unpaid care work. “Women cannot be free from violence while they remain trapped in a system that subordinates them […]...
